name: Attack on Survey Corps
source: Attack on Survey Corps is a game set in Attack on Titan universe. In the game you'll meet a lot of familiar (and fuckable) characters, quests, and stories to follow.​
translation: 《Attack on Survey Corps》是一款设定在《进击的巨人》世界观下的同人游戏。在游戏中，你将邂逅众多熟悉（且可推倒）的角色，体验丰富的任务与剧情故事。
